message:
Insufficient verified image samples for training:
  Healthy: 0 images (minimum 10 required)
  Black Spot / Shell Lesion: 0 images (minimum 10 required)
Place confirmed specimens in C:\Users\nirur\backend\ml\data\black_spot before running training.
pathological_rule: Black Gill (BG) affects gills beneath carapace and CANNOT be relabeled as Black Spot / Shell Lesion (which is a bacterial chitinolytic cuticle erosion). Relabeling unrelated disease images is prohibited.

literature_benchmark.study: Minh-Huy Bui et al., 'A Novel Farm-Level Dataset and Real-Time Detection Framework for Shrimp Black Spot Disease', IEEE ICCITX 2026
literature_benchmark.target: Shrimp Black Spot Disease in Commercial Ponds

instructions: Place verified Healthy shrimp images in backend/ml/data/black_spot/Healthy/ and verified Black-Spot/Shell-Lesion images in backend/ml/data/black_spot/Black_Spot_Shell_Lesion/. Then rerun: python backend/ml/training/train_black_spot_classifier.py
